channel.title: Global Arbitration Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Arbitration Review (globalarbitrationreview.com)

item.title: EFILA looks beyond Europe with relaunch
item.description: The European Federation for Investment Law and Arbitration has relaunched as IFILA and shifted its headquarters from Brussels to the Netherlands as it expands its focus beyond Europe.

item.title: UAE group hires White & Case for claim against Lebanon
item.description: An Emirati conglomerate says it has appointed White & Case for a US$1.7 billion investment treaty claim against Lebanon after being deprived of access to funds deposited in the country’s banks.

item.title: German chemical producer sees off post-M&A claim
item.description: BASF, one of the largest chemical companies in the world, has defeated a post-M&A claim worth €168 million at the German Arbitration Institute.

item.title: OMV wins another award against Gazprom
item.description: A Russian court has ordered Austria’s OMV not to enforce a previously undisclosed ICC award against Gazprom – the latest in a string of awards the company has obtained against the Russian entity.

item.title: Former HKIAC counsel goes solo
item.description: Aditya Kurian, a former HKIAC counsel and practitioner at O’Melveny & Myers, has launched a sole practice in Hong Kong.

item.title: Bermuda centre to launch this year
item.description: After years of delays, Bermuda is set to gain its first dedicated arbitral centre and hearing facility, supported by an advisory committee that includes Dame Elizabeth Gloster KC.

item.title: Chinese companies head to SIAC over Indian electronics deal
item.description: Chinese electronics manufacturer Luxshare has filed a SIAC claim against state-controlled counterpart Wingtech over the sale of an Indian smartphone manufacturing business.

item.title: Ex-ICSID deputy secretary-general launches arbitrator practice
item.description: Gonzalo Flores, who stepped down as ICSID deputy secretary general last October, has established an independent arbitrator practice.

item.title: Spanish court enforces Conoco award against PDVSA
item.description: A Spanish court has enforced an ICC award ordering Venezuela’s state-owned oil group PDVSA to pay US$34 million plus interest to ConocoPhillips relating to an expropriated oil project.

item.title: Singapore court rejects Spain’s state immunity arguments
item.description: The Singapore High Court has upheld the enforcement of a €290 million ICSID award in favour of Dutch renewable energy investors against Spain, rejecting the state’s immunity and EU law arguments.
